title: Help centre
description: Signing in, securing your account and using each space, screen by screen.
captureNote: Screenshots show the interface in French with demo data.
stillStuckText: Write to us from the home page, “Contact us” section.

login.title: Sign in
login.text: Enter your e-mail (or phone) and password, then “Sign in”. You land directly in the space of your role.

mfa.title: Two-step verification (MFA)
mfa.text: After the password, enter the 6-digit code of your authenticator app. Without your phone, use a recovery code: each works only once.

firstLogin.title: First sign-in
firstLogin.text: Sign in with the temporary password you received (valid 72 h), choose a new password within 10 minutes, then turn on two-step verification by scanning the QR shown. Write down your recovery codes.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten password
forgotPassword.text: On the sign-in page, choose “Forgot password”. With an e-mail you get a link valid 15 minutes; with a phone, an SMS code valid 10 minutes.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.text: After a period of inactivity, the session closes to protect your account. A warning appears first; sign in again to continue where you were.

accountLocked.title: Account locked
accountLocked.text: After several wrong attempts, the account is locked for a while. Wait for the delay shown or reset your password. If it stays locked, contact your administrator.

companyDashboard.title: Dashboard
companyDashboard.text: One card per credit type shows the company’s available balance, with orders to pay and recent activity.

companyEmployees.title: Employees
companyEmployees.text: Add employees one by one or by CSV import; each receives beneficiary access. You can suspend an account.

companyOrders.title: Credit orders
companyOrders.text: Enter an amount per type, submit, then transfer the sum to the account shown and upload the transfer proof. FlexiPay validates and credits each type.

companyAllocation.title: Allocation
companyAllocation.text: Choose a credit type and the employees, with an amount each: only that type is debited. For many people, import a CSV with one column per type.

companyInvoices.title: Invoices
companyInvoices.text: Each validated order produces an invoice you can download as PDF.

merchantDashboard.title: Dashboard
merchantDashboard.text: Today’s takings, amounts to receive and the split per credit type.

merchantCollect.title: Collect
merchantCollect.text: Enter the 8-digit code shown by the customer and the amount; they confirm with their PIN. The customer can also scan your FlexiPay QR shown on this screen.

merchantHistory.title: History
merchantHistory.text: All payments, filterable by status and type; open one to see the commission and settlement date.

merchantReceivables.title: Receivables
merchantReceivables.text: Confirmed amounts to be settled at D+2, day by day.

merchantPayouts.title: Payouts
merchantPayouts.text: Request the payout of your available funds: gross, commission and net are shown before sending. FlexiPay checks then transfers to your IBAN.

merchantSettlements.title: Settlements
merchantSettlements.text: Settlement statements, with the detail of included payments.

merchantShop.title: My shop
merchantShop.text: Your details, masked IBAN, accepted credit types and commission rates.

employeeHome.title: My balance
employeeHome.text: One balance per type, with what you spent today against the daily limit and credits about to expire.

employeePay.title: Pay
employeePay.text: “My code” shows a QR and 8 digits valid 60 seconds: the merchant types them, you confirm with your PIN. “Pay a merchant”: scan their QR or type their 6-digit code.

employeeHistory.title: History and receipts
employeeHistory.text: Payments, credits received and expiries, filterable by type; each line opens a printable receipt.

employeeSecurity.title: Profile and security
employeeSecurity.text: See your details, change your password and payment PIN, and regenerate your recovery codes.

adminDashboard.title: Overview
adminDashboard.text: Monthly volumes per type, pending tasks (orders, KYC, payouts, approvals) and recent activity.

adminAccounts.title: Merchants and companies
adminAccounts.text: Create and follow accounts; in a merchant’s record, set the credit types it accepts.

adminKyc.title: KYC files
adminKyc.text: Open a file, view the documents, approve or reject with a reason. The account stays inactive until KYC is approved.

adminOrders.title: Orders
adminOrders.text: Confirm orders, check the transfer proof and validate: each type is then credited. Above 10,000.000 TND, a second administrator must validate.

adminPayouts.title: Merchant payouts and settlements
adminPayouts.text: Check each request (gross, commission, net, IBAN), approve or reject with a reason. Approved payouts form a settlement batch.

adminSettings.title: Commissions, approvals and settings
adminSettings.text: Per type: commission, validity, daily limit, activation. Every sensitive change is approved by another administrator and logged in the audit log.

adminTransactions.title: Transactions and audit log
adminTransactions.text: All platform operations, filterable by credit type, and the history of sensitive actions.

adminMessages.title: Messages
adminMessages.text: Messages sent from “Contact us” on the home page. Open one, answer by e-mail or phone, then mark it as handled.
